research:
Usage (BBR 2025-26): Trae 28.1% (15 g; 2024-25 ATL much higher), Davis 27.5% (20 g DAL), Sarr 25.7%, Herro 24.7% (33 g MIA), Rollins 24.2%, Kuzma 21.8%, K. George 22.8%. Herro was traded to MIL in the Giannis deal (ESPN), and Trae and Davis joined WSH. Every role is new, so I blended 2024-25 logs for Trae, Davis and Herro.
DvP (my FanDuel-scoring computation from 1,231 ESPN 2025-26 box scores; rank 1 = most allowed): WSH vs G 2nd (122.4), F 1st, C 2nd. MIL vs G 6th (119.3), F 10th, C 28th. Both defenses were bottom-5 overall (WSH DRtg 122.7, MIL 119.3).
Ladders (2024-25 + 2025-26): Herro 14+ pts 93.6% (110 g), 2+ reb 98%, 2+ ast 95.5%. Trae 11+ pts 94.5%, 6+ ast 93.4% (91 g), 1+ reb 94.5%. Davis 5+ reb 93.0% (71 g), 6+ reb 91.5%, assists never reach 93% above 0.5, so I dropped that leg.
SGP: Herro o13.5 pts + Trae o5.5 ast + Davis o4.5 reb. Raw product 0.813, shrunk to 0.74 (Davis's early exits in 2025-26, Trae's quad history, new roles). No SGP or alt prices were posted; the estimated implied ~0.89 (about -770) gives no edge, so no highlight. Higher rungs (Herro 20+ at 69%) would reach the -200 band, but they fail the 93% rule.
Props found: Herro o23.5 pts -103 / u -133 (SportsGambler); Trae pts+ast 29.5 (Lineups.com, over); Davis o20.5 pts -120/-122 (bettor pick cited in search); Kel'el Ware o7.5 reb +106 and o9.5 pts +147 (Kalshi via Dimers).
Totals (method, BBR 2025-26): pace avg (97.6 MIL, 101.4 WSH) = 99.5. MIL = avg(112.9, 122.7) x 0.995 = 117.2. WSH = avg(111.0, 119.3) x 0.995 = 114.6. Total 231.8 vs DK 239.5, 7.7 under, so the total goes in as a leg. Caveat: both rosters were rebuilt, so last season's ratings are the stalest of tonight's four games.
Score model: MIL +2.6 before home court, so WSH is about a pick'em versus the -4.5 line.
Injuries (ESPN, Oct 21): WSH out AJ Dybantsa (ankle sprain, No. 1 pick, hurt in the preseason finale per ClutchPoints), Tristan Vukcevic (hip), Jamir Watkins (ACL, season). MIL: Nate Ament day-to-day (ankle; listed probable by SI).
Preseason (ESPN boxes): Trae 28 min with 11 and 7 assists in two starts; Davis 16/7, 14/11, 10/11; Herro 18, 13, 11, 25 in 19-24 min; Ware 18/12 and 14/12; Rollins 8-15 pts starting next to Herro.
Coaching: WSH's Brian Keefe plays fast (101.4 pace). MIL (Doc Rivers in 2025-26) was 97.6. Washington is the most-changed roster: Trae, Davis, Ayton and Middleton join Sarr, George, Coulibaly and Carrington.
Lines (ESPN/DK): WSH -4.5 (-105) / MIL +4.5 (-115), opened -6.5; ML WSH -175 / MIL +145 (open -238/+195); total 239.5 o -112 / u -108 (open 238.5). AP had WSH -5.5 and 238.5; TheRX -6.5 (BetOnline); TheSpread 238.5.
Experts: SI MIL +4.5 (and could win outright); SportsGambler MIL +4.5 and Under 239.5 (117-116); SportsMole MIL; Picks and Parlays MIL +6.5; FOX/iHeart model Under 238.5; SportyTrader WSH -4.5; ESPN BPI WSH 64.9%.
Win totals: WSH 34.5 (BetMGM, Fantasy Alarm/VSiN preview). The Davis-Trae fit is the big unknown; Trae said he will be the 'weak link' defensively (Bleacher Report).
Last season: WSH 17-65, MIL 32-50 with Giannis in only 36 games.
Most likely winner: Herro o13.5 points. He cleared it in 103 of 110 games over two seasons and is now the first option against the league's second-worst guard defense.
